note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The issue cards and subjects are generic and fictional. The substituted datum is the supplied state of the third issue card: “agreed issue” only means the supplied list marks it as agreed between the parties; “open issue” is a neutral pending state; both have equal weight and nothing is decided or proven. No procedure, court power, binding effect, time limit or outcome is shown.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Default fictional example: the lens on the sorting board; the third card’s supplied state changes from ● agreed to ◆ open and the card moves into the ◆ column.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: A different fictional dispute about a shared garden with other people, case file, issues, subjects and days; the opposite substitution (◆ open → ● agreed).

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long labels: long party names and roles, case file, issue labels, subjects, state captions, six day labels, before and after values, caption and marker label (each longer than the baseline; never fewer items).
